Chapter II · Developer profile

Aura Israel

Aura is a Tel Aviv Stock Exchange-listed developer that concentrates on urban renewal, replacing ageing housing blocks with new residential districts.

At a glance

Listed on TASE
Yes (AURA)
Founder and CEO
Adv. Yaacov Atrakchi (controlling shareholder)
Focus
Urban renewal
Netanya flagship
AURA THE STRIP, Ben Zvi Street
Official website (opens in a new tab)

Aura Israel, whose listed entity trades on the Tel Aviv Stock Exchange as Aura Investments, was founded and is run by its controlling shareholder, lawyer Yaacov Atrakchi. The company presents itself primarily as an urban renewal specialist, working with owners of older buildings to demolish and rebuild them at higher density under pinui-binui and similar schemes, while also developing some new neighbourhoods.

Its pipeline is spread across the country, from Haifa and the Krayot in the north to Jerusalem, the Tel Aviv metropolitan area and the south. In Netanya, Aura is behind one of the city's largest renewal plans: a multi-building redevelopment along Ben Zvi Street, branded AURA THE STRIP, which pairs new residential towers with commercial space and public facilities within walking distance of the beach. As with most renewal schemes, its timetable depends on planning approvals and agreement among existing owners.

Key areas of activity

  • Urban renewal (pinui-binui)
  • Large-scale residential redevelopment
  • New residential neighbourhoods
  • Mixed-use projects with commercial space

Projects & neighbourhoods

Information on availability, specifications and pricing is published only by Aura Israel.

01 Urban renewal (pinui-binui) · Ben Zvi Street, central NetanyaAURA THE STRIP (Netanya Ben Tzvi)A redevelopment of about 30 dunams bounded by Ben Zvi, Shmorak, Simcha Erlich and Greenbaum streets, planned as 11 buildings of 10 to 40 floors with commercial space, schools and a park. Aura describes it as the largest pinui-binui project in Netanya.
